rationale: User try: shrink then grow the window turned the whole shell black. Cause: each frame uploaded a new viewport-sized RenderImage to GPUI's sprite atlas and dropped the previous one. Reallocating a larger tile after a smaller one can fail and take chrome text with it. Fix: cache per-glyph RenderImages (stable ImageId) and paint cell backgrounds as quads. Decision 009's CPU composite stays as history; it is not the live paint path.
